scope: Theorem 2.5 (Purely electric spacetime Penrose inequality) of the manuscript “A Charged Reduction of the Spacetime Penrose Inequality in Spatial Dimensions at Least Four” (preprints/A-Charged-Reduction-of-the-Spacetime-Penrose-Inequality-in-Spatial-Dimensions-at-Least-Four-October-5-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 260 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 3e5e445d305051a1), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 7. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Assume Theorem 2.4. For every exterior in Definition 2.1, with full enclosing area as in Definition 2.3, 0 < a ≤ Areag(S), EADM > |PADM|. (2.16) Consequently the invariant mass m = √ E2 ADM − |PADM|2 is well defined and positive, and m ≥ |Q|, XA ≤ m + √ m2 − Q2. (2.17) Equivalently, the mass-charge bound applies when 0 < XA ≤ |Q|, whereas m ≥ 1 2 ( XA + Q2 XA ) when XA > |Q|. (2.18) For Q = 0 this is m ≥ XA/2.
